notes.title: Want to see one of your horror ideas in a game?
notes.content:
Security: Stories by the fans is out now! :D

This game is a free prologue to Security: The Horrible Nights. All story ideas in this prologue come from players who have written and submitted them on the Security: The Horrible Nights Steam page.

We will make a free DLC for Security: The Horrible Nights after it is released, based on even more ideas from you! Do you have an idea that you'd like us to see, so it might make it into the game? Share it on Security: The Horrible Nights Steam page here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2911390/discussions/0/4514379280323767599/

Thanks to EVERYONE who came up with ideas for the game. They've been fun to read and try to mix together into unique little horror stories!
- John & Maria
Professional Villains
